Carbonyl selections concentrate on uncovered stronger-eluent regimes and loading-qualified extensions after the latest feedback reduced the need to remeasure already repaired middle segments. The amino-compound curves and matched amino-nitrile isomers probe nitrogen connectivity and substitution boundaries with clear nearby measured references. The m72 panel tests an early ratio slope and transfer between complete recorded injection tuples, while explicitly preserving the solvent/volume confounding. Aromatic-ether pairs and the iodotoluene extension cover missing response relationships relevant to numerous less-polar rows, rather than adding unrelated chemical diversity. Ratio-response pairs hold density, sample volume, loading-solvent identity, and loading-solvent volume fixed. The sole selected exact replicate matches a previously observed m73 tuple; no two selected rows have identical molecule-plus-condition tuples. These labels may improve overall Row V1/V2 accuracy by constraining transferable slopes, structural boundaries, recorded loading interactions, and regions where label variability limits deterministic prediction. The plan does not optimize the selected separations or seek maximal retention. Loading amount is the density-times-volume feature, and no absent concentration, pH, flow, or column variables are assumed. Quantile spans and CW distances are supplementary evidence; they are not calibrated epistemic uncertainty. Elution interval width is distinct from prediction uncertainty, and the m73 endpoint-order inconsistencies are treated explicitly."}
